caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, ornate metal object with a symmetrical design featuring scrolling, leaf-like patterns and a central ridge, resembling stylized foliage. The object is roughly triangular with rounded, curling edges and a circular loop at one end, suggesting it could be a handle or decorative fitting. There are three renderings: a large three-dimensional perspective of the object placed in the lower right, a flat top-down view placed in the upper left, and a side profile with a measurement scale showing the object's thickness and two supporting legs just below the top-down view. The background is plain and uncolored, and the structure is illustrated in shades of gray and black, emphasizing the object's detailed texture and the shadows cast by its raised elements.
title: Flat Iron Holder
